name: Facet
text: Implement a single, high-contrast dark theme for EXCAVA's interface, ensuring a visually appealing and clear user experience. This design choice enhances visibility in various lighting conditions and supports user engagement through a sleek, modern look. The trade-off is that we limit customization options for users who prefer lighter themes, but prioritizing clarity and enjoyment with a unified dark aesthetic will create a more cohesive environment. This decision aligns with our goal of liveliness and speed in our interface.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t just limiting customization—it’s locking ourselves into a single aesthetic that may not suit all users or contexts. A better alternative is a system-wide dark theme by default with a *light* mode toggle for rare overrides, preserving consistency while accommodating edge cases. Settle it by testing both in live prototypes with real users—if light mode usage stays below 5%, we keep the single dark theme; otherwise, we build the toggle.
